provenance: Deterministic project-authored synthetic Python microtasks; exposed expression in prompt makes this a transparent smoke benchmark, not an independent professional benchmark

tasks.goal: Implement add(a,b) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: a+b. Preserve the function name.
Implement subtract(a,b) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: a-b. Preserve the function name.
Implement multiply(a,b) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: a*b. Preserve the function name.
Implement square(x) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: x*x. Preserve the function name.
Implement is_even(n) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: n%2==0. Preserve the function name.
tasks.acceptance: assert is_even(4) is True and is_even(3) is False

tasks.goal: Implement reverse_text(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: text[::-1]. Preserve the function name.
Implement word_count(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: len(text.split()). Preserve the function name.
tasks.acceptance: assert word_count(" a  b ")==2 and word_count("")==0

tasks.goal: Implement clamp(x,lo,hi) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: max(lo,min(hi,x)). Preserve the function name.
Implement safe_divide(a,b) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: a/b if b else None. Preserve the function name.
tasks.acceptance: assert safe_divide(6,2)==3 and safe_divide(1,0) is None
tasks.control_patch:
def safe_divide(a,b):
    return a/b if b else None

tasks.goal: Implement unique_ordered(items) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: list(dict.fromkeys(items)). Preserve the function name.
Implement flatten(rows) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: [x for row in rows for x in row]. Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def flatten(rows):
    return [x for row in rows for x in row]

tasks.goal: Implement positive_only(items) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: [x for x in items if x>0]. Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def positive_only(items):
    return [x for x in items if x>0]

tasks.goal: Implement sum_squares(items) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: sum(x*x for x in items). Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def sum_squares(items):
    return sum(x*x for x in items)

tasks.goal: Implement normalize_space(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: " ".join(text.split()). Preserve the function name.
Implement slugify(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: "-".join(text.lower().split()). Preserve the function name.
Implement celsius_to_fahrenheit(c) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: c*9/5+32. Preserve the function name.
Implement count_vowels(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: sum(c in "aeiou" for c in text.lower()). Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def count_vowels(text):
    return sum(c in "aeiou" for c in text.lower())

tasks.goal: Implement first_nonempty(items) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: next((x for x in items if x),None). Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def first_nonempty(items):
    return next((x for x in items if x),None)

tasks.goal: Implement invert_mapping(mapping) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: {v:k for k,v in mapping.items()}. Preserve the function name.
tasks.control_patch:
def invert_mapping(mapping):
    return {v:k for k,v in mapping.items()}

tasks.goal: Implement is_palindrome(text) as a pure Python function. Required behavior: text==text[::-1]. Preserve the function name.
tasks.acceptance: assert is_palindrome("level") is True and is_palindrome("code") is False
